# Samuel Emeka (Web Phoenix)

> Portfolio of Samuel Emeka, who goes by Web Phoenix online: a developer and designer who builds products and brand identities, from the logo to the backend.

## Pages
- [Home](https://webphoenix.net/): the short version, with selected work, services and experience
- [Work](https://webphoenix.net/work): every project, with filters
- [Services and pricing](https://webphoenix.net/services): websites, brand identities, apps and design, with prices and a package builder
- [About](https://webphoenix.net/about): who Samuel is and what he is working on now
- [Brand portfolio](https://webphoenix.net/brand): logos, mascots and poster work
- [Socials and contact](https://webphoenix.net/socials): email, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, LinkedIn

## Roles
- Co-founder, designer and developer at Pendu (voice, chat and calls for gaming communities)
- Head software engineer at Vowrify (protected payments for big purchases)
- Backend developer at Rendo, formerly Rentipede (hostels and rental housing)
